answers.bix-5-q1: No biological process shows statistically significant enrichment in diseased versus control fibroblast samples at conventional FDR thresholds; the weakest gene-level signal has FDR≈0.88, so no GO term can be robustly prioritized as “most enriched.”
answers.bix-5-q4: Similarly, no biological process can be identified as significantly enriched in ASXL1‑mutated fibroblasts based on this dataset, because no genes reach conventional significance in the disease–control contrast (minimum FDR≈0.88), precluding reliable GO enrichment results.
